records.name: Angular UInputMask
records.purpose: Native text input that formats typed and pasted characters against a mask pattern and reports completion and the unmasked value.
records.surface: Component selector u-input-mask; standalone, OnPush, ViewEncapsulation.None; extends UBaseInput and provides NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR (useExisting UInputMask, multi). Template is one native <input type=text> (ViewChild inputEl) with keypress, keydown, input, paste, focus and blur handlers and disabled/readonly/placeholder/maxlength/minlength/size attributes. Signal inputs: mask, slotChar ('_'), autoClear (true), characterPattern ('[A-Za-z]'), unmask, readonly, placeholder, invalid. Outputs: onCompleteEvent: output<void>() and onUnmaskedChange: output<string>(). onFocus/onBlur are protected handlers, not outputs. writeControlValue override reformats a written string through the mask buffer; the model value is the unmasked or the formatted buffer string according to unmask(). From UBaseInput it inherits signal inputs fluid, variant, size, inputSize, pattern, min, max, step, minlength and maxlength; from UBaseEditableHolder disabled, the ControlValueAccessor methods writeValue/registerOnChange/registerOnTouched/setDisabledState, and from UModelHolder the modelValue/$filled signals. hasFluid is true when fluid() is set or an ancestor UFluid provides U_FLUID_ANCESTOR. componentName input-mask; ngOnInit builds the mask definitions. Public API: UInputMask (class). Host class cx('root', {invalid, fluid}); inner input uses cx('pcInputText') = 'u-inputtext', so its look relies on the inputtext class name coupling rather than an import. No dedicated Aura registry key (aura/index.ts records that inputmask has no upstream module and reuses InputText tokens). Owned source-only declarations: InputMaskClassesParams, inputMaskStyleModule (root 'u-inputmask u-component' with p-invalid and u-inputmask-fluid). No dedicated component-metadata record exists in the current records directory. Inherits dt: Record<string, unknown>|undefined and unstyled: boolean|undefined from UBaseComponent; these declared inputs are not evidence that unstyled suppresses registration. Also exposed via @ultimate/ng/input-mask. Style module exports and class-parameter interfaces are source-only internals, not barrel exports or independent rendered components.

records.name: Angular UInputText
records.purpose: Styles a native input element in place, mirrors its value into model state for filled styling, and exposes size, pass-through, unstyled and per-instance dt; not a wrapping component.
records.surface: Attribute directive (selector [uInputText], exportAs uInputText) applied to a native <input>, not a wrapping component; there is no template. Standalone; extends UModelHolder directly (skipping UBaseEditableHolder) so it has no disabled input of its own. It injects NgControl optionally (self) read-only and does not implement ControlValueAccessor or provide NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR: Angular's native DefaultValueAccessor stays the only accessor, and the directive only mirrors NgControl.value (or the native value) into modelValue/$filled for styling via the native input event, ngAfterViewInit, NgControl.valueChanges (takeUntilDestroyed) and ngDoCheck. Optionally injects an ancestor UFluid (host, skipSelf); hasFluid is fluid() ?? presence of that ancestor. Signal inputs: variant ('filled'|'outlined'|undefined), uSize ('small'|'large'|undefined, named so it does not collide with the native size attribute), fluid and invalid (boolean attribute transforms). Computed $variant. hostDirectives [UBind]; ngAfterViewChecked applies ptms(['host','root']) to the input, so pt and ptOptions reach it. Host binds class via cx('root', classesParams()) and host attribute data-p from a cn() token string (invalid, fluid, variant-derived filled, size token). The p-filled class is value-derived ($filled). componentName inputtext; imports cn from @ultimate/uix-utils/classnames. Public API: UInputText (class). The doc comment records the omitted hostName lookup, inputSize attribute and NgModule wrapper; no outputs are declared. Theme identity inputtext matches componentName and the Aura components registry; dt() resolves those token references via base registration. CSS comes from @ultimate/uix-styles/inputtext (style import) with local inputTextStyleModule supplying css/classes: root class 'u-inputtext u-component' plus p-filled, p-invalid, u-inputtext-fluid, p-variant-filled, u-inputtext-sm and u-inputtext-lg modifiers; the local css adds the Angular-only .u-inputtext.ng-invalid.ng-dirty border and placeholder rules. Owned source-only declarations: InputTextClassesParams, inputTextStyleModule. No dedicated component-metadata record exists in the current records directory. Inherits dt, unstyled, pt and ptOptions from UBaseComponent (ADR-077, ADR-085); a unit test shows unstyled drops the classes and dt writes a scoped variable block, and ptOptions has no visible effect until the global pt source exists (ADR-080). The decisions for this family are in ADR-086. No dedicated manifest subpath; root entry only. Style module exports and class-parameter interfaces are source-only internals, not barrel exports or independent rendered components.

records.name: Angular UPassword
records.purpose: Password field with optional visibility toggle and an overlay strength meter driven by configurable regular expressions.
records.surface: Component selector u-password; standalone, OnPush, ViewEncapsulation.None; imports UOverlay and extends UBaseInput; provides NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR. Template: a native input switching type between password and text via the unmasked signal, optional inline SVG toggle icons (role=button, aria-labels 'Show Password'/'Hide Password') when toggleMask, and, when feedback, a uOverlay appended to body containing a meter bar and info text. Signal inputs: ariaLabel, inputId, placeholder, feedback (true), toggleMask (false), promptLabel, weakLabel, mediumLabel, strongLabel, mediumRegex and strongRegex (string patterns). Outputs onFocus: output<Event>() and onBlur: output<Event>() are declared but have no emit site in this source (the handlers only toggle the overlay and mark touched). Strength levels weak/medium/strong set meter width 33.33%/66.66%/100%; Escape key hides the overlay. writeControlValue override normalizes the value to a string and refreshes meter state. There is no invalid input; classesParams passes invalid: false constantly.
